title: Grade 4
summary: Breves, double dots, all regular metres, duplets, alto clef, double accidentals, keys to five sharps/flats, chromatic scale, any diatonic interval, primary triads, ornaments and instruments.

units.title: Breves, double dots, regular metres and duplets
units.summary: New values and every simple/compound duple, triple and quadruple time signature.

units.title: Double accidentals, enharmonics and the alto clef
units.summary: Double sharps/flats, enharmonic equivalents, alto clef and octave transposition into and out of it.
refinements: Alto-clef key signatures move to G4-U3 so that they follow the new five-accidental keys.

units.title: Five-accidental keys, degree names and the chromatic scale
units.summary: B, D♭, G♯ minor, B♭ minor; alto-clef key signatures; technical names; chromatic scale.

units.title: Intervals and primary triads
units.learnerTitle: Intervals and the three main chords
units.summary: Any diatonic interval within an octave; triads and chords on I, IV and V.

units.title: Ornaments, instruments and the passage
units.summary: Ornament signs, orchestral instruments and techniques, Grade 4 terms, reading a passage.

nodes.title: The breve and its rest
nodes.objective: Recognise the breve and the breve rest and use them in 4/2.

nodes.title: Double dots
nodes.objective: Work out the value of double-dotted notes and rests.

nodes.title: All regular time signatures
nodes.objective: Classify any regular time signature as simple/compound and duple/triple/quadruple.

nodes.title: Grouping in the new time signatures
nodes.objective: Group notes and rests in 6/4, 9/4, 12/4, 6/16 and similar times.

nodes.title: Duplets
nodes.objective: Read duplets in compound time and compare with simple time.

nodes.title: Practice: Every regular time
nodes.objective: Mixed independent practice of everything in this unit.

nodes.title: Review: Grade 3 foundations
nodes.objective: Revisit earlier material so it stays fresh.

nodes.title: Unit challenge: Every regular time
nodes.objective: Show independently, without hints, what you can do from this unit.

nodes.title: Double sharps and double flats
nodes.objective: Read, write and cancel double sharps and double flats.

nodes.title: Enharmonic equivalents
nodes.objective: Give other spellings of the same sound and explain when spelling matters.

nodes.title: The alto clef
nodes.objective: Read and write notes in the alto clef, with middle C on the middle line.

nodes.title: The same pitch in three clefs
nodes.objective: Recognise notes of the same pitch in treble, alto and bass clefs.

nodes.title: Octave transposition with the alto clef
nodes.objective: Transpose a melody at the octave from treble or bass into alto, and back.

nodes.objective: Build B major and G♯ minor (both forms), including the double sharp.

nodes.title: Key signatures in the alto clef
nodes.objective: Write key signatures of all Grade 4 keys in the alto clef.

nodes.title: Technical names of degrees
nodes.objective: Name each degree of a diatonic scale: tonic to leading note.

nodes.title: The chromatic scale
nodes.objective: Write a chromatic scale with each letter name used once or twice and sensible accidentals.
